question: What position did France's Monroe finish at Eurovision 2026 in Austria?

steps.content: [Monroe (singer)] Monroe Vata Rigby (born 19 November 2008), known mononymously as Monroe, is an American soprano singer. She represented France in the Eurovision Song Contest 2026 with the song "Regarde!", finishing in eleventh place. She was the last minor to perform on the Eurovision stage before the EBU announced that the minimum participation age would be raised to 18 starting in 2027. She also has performed with Josh Groban, on "Hymne à l'amour". | other articles: France in the Eurovision Song Contest 2026, Eurovision Song Contest 2026
France's Monroe finished in eleventh place at the Eurovision Song Contest 2026 in Austria with the song "Regarde!". FINAL: 11th place.
